content: driveItem: delta (Microsoft Graph v1.0, updated 2026-06-06). Paginate on @odata.nextLink until @odata.deltaLink appears; persist the deltaLink for the next sync. IMPORTANT CORRECTION to the legacy 'resyncRequired' name: v1.0 documents token invalidation as HTTP 410 Gone with error code resyncChangesApplyDifferences or resyncChangesUploadDifferences, plus a Location header containing a fresh nextLink that starts a full re-enumeration. Causes: reusing an old token after a long disconnect, or server state change. ?token=latest returns an empty value array plus the current deltaLink (useful to skip an initial full enumeration). OneDrive for Business/SharePoint also accept a URL-encoded ISO timestamp as token; consumer OneDrive does not. Remarks: delta returns the LATEST STATE per item, not per change; the same item can appear more than once (use the last occurrence); parentReference.path is NOT populated, so track items by id only. Delta omits some properties: business Create/Modify omits ctag, Delete omits ctag+name; consumer Delete omits ctag+size. Delta is the only enumeration guaranteed to return every item when writes happen concurrently - paging /children is not.
